subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core Claws export contract now as part of the ordered RFC stack, or wait until the canonical `CLAW.md` representation is included?
rationale: Current main has no Claws surface, the RFC remains open, and accepting this PR creates new package, CLI, and versioned output contracts whose compatibility direction cannot be inferred from code correctness alone.

options.title: Approve the coordinated stack
options.body: Confirm the RFC direction and land the prerequisite lifecycle, this export slice, and the canonical format follow-up in reviewed dependency order.

options.title: Settle the format first
options.body: Require the first landed export contract to emit the canonical `CLAW.md` representation, avoiding an intermediate JSON-facing contract.

options.title: Pause core adoption
options.body: Keep the stack unlanded until maintainers sponsor the broader Claws product and compatibility model.

recommendation.title: Approve the coordinated stack
recommendation.body: Confirm the RFC direction and land the prerequisite lifecycle, this export slice, and the canonical format follow-up in reviewed dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is core product and compatibility direction rather than a mechanical implementation defect.
